"Not at barely thirteen, would you?" she said. "It seems to me you're just a shade too young to be marrying a man who's already got a wife and several children. Where did you pick up that 'I'd-marry-him-to-morrow,' Florence?"

arxiv-2012-09229.title: Tag-based regulation of modules in genetic programming improves context-dependent problem solving
arxiv-2012-09229.creator: Alexander Lalejini, Matthew Andres Moreno, Charles Ofria
arxiv-2012-09229.description: Abstract We introduce and experimentally demonstrate the utility of tag-based genetic regulation, a new genetic programming (GP) technique that allows programs to dynamically adjust which code modules to express. Tags are evolvable labels that provide a flexible mechanism for referencing code modules.

arxiv-2104-07249.title: Regularization for Long Named Entity Recognition
arxiv-2104-07249.creator: Minbyul Jeong, Jaewoo Kang
arxiv-2104-07249.description: Abstract When performing named entity recognition (NER), entity length is variable and dependent on a specific domain or dataset. Pre-trained language models (PLMs) are used to solve NER tasks and tend to be biased toward dataset patterns such as length statistics, surface form, and skewed class distribution.

arxiv-2108-07050.title: Colour remote sensing of the impact of artificial light at night (II): Calibration of DSLR-based images from the International Space Station Journal: Remote Sensing for Environment
arxiv-2108-07050.creator: Alejandro Sánchez de Miguel, Jaime Zamorano, Martin Aubé, Jonathan Bennie, Jesús Gallego, Francisco Ocaña, Donald R. Pettit, William L. Stefanov, Kevin J. Gaston
arxiv-2108-07050.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alejandro Sánchez de Miguel, Jaime Zamorano, Martin Aubé, Jonathan Bennie, Jesús Gallego, Francisco Ocaña, Donald R. Pettit, William L. Stefanov, Kevin J. Gaston. Nighttime images taken with DSLR cameras from the International Space Station (ISS) can provide valuable information on the spatial and temporal variation of artificial nighttime lighting on Earth. In particular, this is the only source of historical and current visible multispectral data across the world (DMSP/OLS and SNPP/VIIRS-DNB data are panchromatic and multispectral in the infrared but not at visible wavelengths).

arxiv-2204-01150.title: Practical exponential stability of a robust data-driven nonlinear predictive control scheme
arxiv-2204-01150.creator: Mohammad Alsalti, Victor G. Lopez, Julian Berberich, Frank Allgöwer, Matthias A. Müller
arxiv-2204-01150.description: Abstract We provide theoretical guarantees for recursive feasibility and practical exponential stability of the closed-loop system of a discrete-time multi-input multi-output full-state feedback linearizable nonlinear system when controlled by a robust data-driven nonlinear predictive control scheme. Two sources of uncertainties are considered: the mismatch due to the basis function approximation as well as output measurement noise.

arxiv-2212-05353.title: How many cards should you lay out in a game of EvenQuads : A detailed study of caps in A ​ G ​ ( n , 2 ) AG(n,2)
arxiv-2212-05353.creator: Julia Crager, Felicia Flores, Timothy E. Goldberg, Lauren L. Rose, Daniel Rose-Levine, Darrion Thornburgh, Raphael Walker
arxiv-2212-05353.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Julia Crager, Felicia Flores, Timothy E. Goldberg, Lauren L. Rose, Daniel Rose-Levine, Darrion Thornburgh, Raphael Walker. We define a cap in the affine geometry A ​ G ​ ( n , 2 ) AG(n,2) to be a subset in which any collection of 4 points is in general position. In this paper we classify, up to affine equivalence, all caps in A ​ G ​ ( n , 2 ) AG(n,2) of size k ≤ 9 k\leq 9 .

arxiv-2402-00427.title: Ralph Kenna’s scaling relations in critical phenomena
arxiv-2402-00427.creator: Leïla Moueddene, Arnaldo Donoso, Bertrand Berche
arxiv-2402-00427.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Leïla Moueddene, Arnaldo Donoso, Bertrand Berche. Abstract:
In this note, we revisit the scaling relations among “hatted critical exponents” which were first derived by
Ralph Kenna, Des Johnston and Wolfhard Janke, and we propose an alternative derivation for some of them. For the scaling relation involving the behavior of the correlation function, we will propose an alternative form since we believe that the expression is erroneous in the work of Ralph and his collaborators.

arxiv-2409-15695.description: Abstract Semantic Communication (SemCom) plays a pivotal role in 6G networks, offering a viable solution for future efficient communication. Deep Learning (DL)-based semantic codecs further enhance this efficiency. However, the vulnerability of DL models to security threats, such as adversarial attacks, poses significant challenges for practical applications of SemCom systems.

Hardcastle, Tanja Holc, Abigail L. Patrick, Marina I. Arnaudova, Beatriz Mingo, Rachel K. Cochrane, Soumyadeep Das, Paul Haskell, Manuela Magliocchetti, Katarzyna Małek, Georg. arxiv-2412-10450.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yihe Zhang, Bryce Turney, Purushottam Sigdel, Xu Yuan, Eric Rappin, Adrian L. Lago, Sytske Kimball, Li Chen, Paul Darby, Lu Peng, Sercan Aygun, Yazhou Tu, M. Hassan Najafi, Nian-Feng Tzeng. Accurate and timely regional weather prediction is vital for sectors dependent on weather-related decisions. Traditional prediction methods, based on atmospheric equations, often struggle with coarse temporal resolutions and inaccuracies.

arxiv-2501-18998.title: Adversarial Attacks on AI-Generated Text Detection Models: A Token Probability-Based Approach Using Embeddings
arxiv-2501-18998.creator: Ahmed Khalid & Lei Jiao, Rishad Shafik, Ole-Christoffer Granmo
arxiv-2501-18998.description: Abstract In recent years, text generation tools utilizing AI ( AI ) have occasionally been misused across various domains, such as generating student reports or creative writings. This issue prompts plagiarism detection services to enhance their capabilities in identifying AI-generated content. Adversarial attacks are often used to test the robustness of AI-text generated detectors.

arxiv-2505-08559.title: Synthesis of safety certificates for discrete-time uncertain systems via convex optimization footnoteinfo
arxiv-2505-08559.creator: Marta Fochesato, Han Wang, Antonis Papachristodoulou, Paul Goulart
arxiv-2505-08559.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marta Fochesato, Han Wang, Antonis Papachristodoulou, Paul Goulart. We study the problem of co-designing control barrier functions and linear state feedback controllers for discrete-time linear systems affected by additive disturbances. For disturbances of bounded magnitude, we provide a semi-definite program whose feasibility implies the existence of a control law and a certificate ensuring safety in the infinite horizon with respect to the worst-case disturbance realization in the uncertainty set.

pmc-11507219.title: Optimization of Desalting Conditions for the Green Seaweed Codium fragile for Use as a Functional Food with Hypnotic Effects
pmc-11507219.creator: Sohong Park, Duhyeon Kim, Seonghui Kim, Gibeom Choi, Hodeung Yoo, Serim Park, Suengmok Cho
pmc-11507219.description: Codium fragile (CF) contains various bioactive compounds, but its high salt content (39.8%) makes its use as a functional food challenging. Here, we aimed to optimize the desalination process and verify changes in functionality based on variations in salt and total phenolic contents.

pmc-12542332.title: Evaluating student nurses satisfaction with educational escape rooms as a pedagogical approach to teaching professional nursing values
pmc-12542332.creator: Nicola Rowley, Sandra Lucas

pmc-12861619.title: Pulmonary Tumor Thrombotic Microangiopathy With Biventricular Heart Failure
pmc-12861619.creator: Yutaka Mihara, Daisuke Miyahara, Norio Suzuki, Yasuhiro Tanabe, Tomoko Norose, Chie Okawa, Naoki Shimada, Ruka Aoki, Yoshihiro J Akashi
pmc-12861619.description: BackgroundPulmonary tumor thrombotic microangiopathy (PTTM), a rare and often fatal condition characterized by tumor cell embolization within pulmonary arterioles, is frequently diagnosed using pulmonary artery aspiration cytology. PTTM is associated with poor prognosis.Case SummaryA 51-year-old woman with ovarian cancer presented with biventricular heart failure and reduced left ventricular ejection fraction.

pmc-13194222.title: Health-related quality-of-life of WHO grade 4 astrocytoma patients receiving alternating electrical field therapy: a prospective real-world multi-centre study
pmc-13194222.creator: Desiree K K Wong, Jenny K S Pu, Lai-Fung Li, Victor K H Hui, Kevin K F Suen, Arthur C K Lau, Danny T M Chan, Michael W Y Lee, Tony K T Chan, Jason M K Ho, Ka-Man Cheung, Teresa P K Tse, Sarah S N Lau, Joyce S W Chow, Michael K W See, Natalie M W Ko, Herbert H F Loong, Dennis K C Leung, Aya El-Helali
pmc-13194222.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeAlternating electric fields (AEF) therapy has been shown to improve the overall survival of patients with WHO grade 4 astrocytoma. Few have explored its impact on health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL) and caregiver stress.MethodsThis was a prospective, multi-centre, registry-based study of adult patients with WHO grade 4 astrocytoma who received either AEF plus temozolomide chemoradiotherapy (AEF + CRT) or CRT alone, with EORTC QLQ-C30/BN20, CSI, and HK-MoCA assessments at baseline and every three months.

pmc-13199504.title: A multi-criteria sustainability and engine performance study of andropogon narudus biodiesel using the PUGH matrix and ML
pmc-13199504.creator: Elumalai PV, C Ahamed Saleel, Mohammad Imtiyaz Gulbarga, Fayaz Hussain, Sher Afghan Khan, Parvathy Rajendran, Chaloemphol Kaewthep, Xu Yong
pmc-13199504.description: The present work provides an experimental, sustainability, and ML-based analysis of Andropogon Nardus biodiesel as a potential second-generation green fuel for compression ignition engines. The biodiesel blends (AN20, AN30, and AN40) were then used on a single-cylinder direct-injection diesel engine over the 25–100% load range and at injection pressures of 190, 210, and 230 bar.

pmc-13299286.title: Effects of an 8-Week Time-Restricted Eating and Walking Exercise on Regional Fat Distribution and Lean Mass in Women with Hidden Obesity: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13299286.creator: Shiying Chen, Jakub Kortas, Yulong Ren, Huan Zhou, Haitao Liu
pmc-13299286.description: Objectives: Explore and compare the effects of 8-week time-restricted eating (TRE), walking exercise, and their combination on fat and lean muscle distribution in female college students with hidden obesity. Methods: A total of 68 participants were randomly assigned to four groups: Control (CON), TRE, Exercise (EXE), and TRE + EXE.

pmc-13545862.title: Correlation of serum ferritin, D dimer and CRP levels with disease severity among hospitalized patients in India
pmc-13545862.creator: Madhur Gupta, Girish Dubey, Ritesh Yadav, Ramesh Prasad Agrawal
pmc-13545862.description: Delayed recognition of severe disease in hospitalized patients remains a major challenge and contributes to increased morbidity and mortality. Therefore, it is of interest to evaluate the correlation of serum ferritin, C-reactive protein (CRP) and D-dimer levels with disease severity in hospitalized patients.

pmc-13626943.title: Rimegepant for vestibular and cochlear symptoms associated with vertigo in a real-world retrospective study

pmc-13626943.description: SummaryVertigo commonly co-occurs with cochlear symptoms, yet evidence for calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) receptor antagonists across audiovestibular disorders remains limited. We retrospectively evaluated 54 adults with vertigo who received rimegepant 75 mg daily or every other day for 8 weeks.
